messages.subject: Error loading occurrence data
parts:
Hello! I have a .csv file that won’t load into Wallace. It says that the upload is complete but after pressing “Load occurrences” nothing happens i.e. there is no progress bar in the bottom right corner and no message of error in RStudio.

The link to the file is here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E8XwpwYkCFm0OCePsqWH1s6PUdTKps_Q/view?usp=sharing

Any help is greatly appreciated!

I’m using Wallace (v2.1.1).

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error loading occurrence data
parts:
Hi Anna,
You'll need to reorder the columns so that the the second column is 'longitude' and the third column is 'latitude'. The first column must be 'scientific_name', which is correct in your file, and the other columns may remain, in any order.

For others trying to load a .csv file, the first three columns must be: scientific_name, longitude, latitude.

messages.subject: Re: Privatna poruka na temu: Error loading occurrence data
parts:
Hi Ana,
Check the log window for an error message. If you see something like, "There is something wrong in your file. Check file format or delimiter and decimal separators." then there continues to be an issue with the file, and check those items.
However, if you hit Load occurrences, and it looks like it isn't doing anything, it may be just taking a while loading your occurrences (you have a lot!). I cut your data to just 2000 records and was able to get it to load. You can try removing some records, or letting it run for a while to see if the whole dataset loads...
